reviews.t: Soft effect but no enhancing abilities!
reviews.x: This product smells good and makes my hair feel soft but I was very disappointed with is curl enhancing abilities. I have frizzy wavy hair with more curls by my neckline than all over. So i bought this hoping, like some products, that it would enhance and encourage my curls throughout but without the hard crunchy effect. It did not do that. So I think people would love this product if they want a light soft frizz free curl that don't need any help getting more curls out of your hair. Hope this h
Doesn't seem to work... makes my wavy hair sticky & frizzy at the same time, somehow & feels heavy. I tried using less/more & it didn't seem to matter.

I decided to try out this product to replace the Cantu Shea Butter leave-in, which I have used for over a year. I like it, but I felt like it wasn’t giving me as good results as it used to.  I like this product because it contains a lot of natura extracts, and it smells amazing. It also did a great job of leaving my 3a curls looking shiny, defined, and volumized without looking greasy.  I used a quarter sized drop my my whole head. My hair is very dense and comes to my collarbone at the longest

Seems great so far! I have fine, wavy hair, so I’m always looking for a product that won’t weigh it down or make it crunchy.  This is light weight, giving definition and a surprising amount of volume!  I felt amazing on day one and got several compliments from coworkers.

I only use Oscensia products on my hair. They leave it soft, shiny, and feeling healthy. The curl cream is not as strong a hold as Catwalk, but it also doesn't leave my hair all stiff and crunchy feeling like the Catwalk does. Whether I let it dry naturally or use a diffuser, my hair is just soft, wavy, and smelling nice.

reviews.t: A great alternative for Lush's R&B
reviews.x: This is only 4 oz, which is not a lot at all. However, this is a great alternative for Lush's R&B Hair Moisturizer. Both give your hair some natural moisture, hold and shine... but not too much. And it's great for fine hair like mine, which doesn't need a lot of product. If your hair is THIRSTY this is not for you- you'll go through it in no time at all and it'll hurt your wallet.  If you hair is like mine- fine, liable for getting weighed down by product- this is for you. My hair is very long,

I LOVE!!! this product. By far the best product I've used for my curly, shoulder-length hair, and I've used a lot of products over the years. It seems to be weightless, yet it does promote curls. It leaves my hair soft and full, but I hardly notice that I have product in my hair. Sometimes my hair looks better the day after I've washed it! I can now go about three days between washings, which does a lot to combat dryness. My hair stays full and curly and looks clean the whole time. Sometimes I'l

I have only been using this product for a short time but, both my hair and I love it so far. I really need a haircut so I am sure that I will love this product even more when I am not so shaggy. It does not make my hair crunchy, goopy or weigh it down. The size of the container makes it great for travel. I would like a larger size for home use however I will take what I can get happily. The seller is very reliable and does follow up on the sake of the product and this can be very useful. Try thi

I was amazed at how well this product works. I have been looking for something to replace my old hair product which was discontinued and after using this, I'm not using anything else. PLEASE DON'T DISCONTINUE! At first I was disappointed at how little the bottle was for the price, but you really only need to use a small amount of product to get incredible curls. The smell is also a bonus; it smells like citrus.

I bought several products trying to get my naturally wavy hair to curl a bit more.  The other product was a disaster, but this one seems to work the best.  It has a lovely smell, thick texture requiring the use of only a tiny drop, and my hair IS curlier.  So far, so good.  4 stars because my 'curls' are minimal (and I have short hair).
Great product!  I put it into my daughters hair. She has very wild untameable hair and this definitely helps not the chaos. Will recommend!

reviews.t: Not as effective as others on market
reviews.x: Cream is nice but not as effective in developing waves and curls that I have used in past. Would not order again.

reviews.t: I love it. I just wish the quantity was more
reviews.x: I was a little shocked when I opened the box and saw how little the bottle is. The only down size to this is literally the downsize... it is a very small bottle for the price. But it works so well and smells delicious, sort of a citrusy smell that you almost want to eat! I love it. I just wish the quantity was more. A little does go a long way though so one bottle will last a good few weeks. I use to need all kinds of product for my hair, I have very frizzy hair and live in a high humidity state

reviews.t: Keeps curls soft and nice the whole day
reviews.x: My daughter is extremely gappycwuth the creme  I bought her l. She has curly hair that tends to get frizzy and unruly and since she startwd using Osana Curl defining cream they stay soft and gorgeous. Her friends are all asking about this

reviews.t: Fantastic product for girls with curls
reviews.x: I will buy the large bottle next time. This is amazing!  I work on a ranch, so I’m in the wind and weather for hours each day. This is my first day to use Curl Defining Cream, but I came home from the ranch finger placed and tossed my curls and I’m ready for a business dinner with my husband.

I tried using this cream before and after drying and in varying amounts, but no matter what I did, my hair always came out feeling crispy.  And the smell of this cream wasn't entirely pleasant...it reminded me of cilantro, in a weird, chemical-ly way.

reviews.t: This isn't the best Deva product.
reviews.x: I usually like the Deva line of hair products but this didn't do anything special for my hair and left it kind of greasy. I'm throwing it out.
This is what I have been looking for for years!! It is perfect for air drying my wavy hair and holds up for days.
Great product I used to design my hair and holds long and curly shiny hair. Fast service

reviews.t: Works good for me on the second day after wash
reviews.x: This product was a little bit stiffening on the first day after wash, but I tried it on the second day, on unwashed hair, and it worked pretty well to help recover the natural curl. It smells great. (I'm still looking for an affordable product that keeps the curl without adding any weight or crunch.)

Almost every single curly hair product I've used and LOVED has been discontinued (the worst!), so I thought I'd give this a try.  A bit more expensive than I'm used to paying, but it smells good, doesn't leave the curls crunchy, and it's amazing for frizziness.  I'm hooked!

A little goes a long way and does outstanding job to keep my tight curls prone to look freezy, look shiny and well organized! I tried a lot of different products and came to a conclusion tha this one is perfect for me personally!
It works okay, not the greatest amount of curls I've ever seen with a defining product but it does hold some of my curl and keeps some of the frizz out. I'll probably buy another product next time.
I bought this on a whim from the reviews and am so glad I did! I have fine, wavy hair and this cream helps tame the frizz and gives my normally-dull waves beautiful definition.
My boyfriend uses it on his waves, i use it on my curls. Great product! I want to order more but i have to many other products in stock.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it defines curls and leaves hair soft, shiny, and not crunchy.
Several reviewers praise the scent, describing it as lovely or citrusy.
Some reviewers find it lightweight and non-greasy, though a few say it feels sticky, heavy, or frizzy.
Multiple reviewers complain the bottle is small for the price.
A few reviewers say it did not enhance curls or waves as much as expected.
